  • Method Details

    • encoder

      RSocketStrategies.Builder encoder(Encoder<?>... encoder)
      Append to the list of encoders to use for serializing Objects to the data or metadata of a Payload.

      默认情况下，该对象使用针对 `String`、`byte[]`、`ByteBuffer` 和 `DataBuffer` 的编码器进行初始化。

    • encoders

      RSocketStrategies.Builder encoders(Consumer<List<Encoder<?>>> consumer)
      立即将消费者应用于配置的编码器列表。

    • decoder

      RSocketStrategies.Builder decoder(Decoder<?>... decoder)
      Append to the list of decoders to use for de-serializing Objects from the data or metadata of a Payload.

      默认情况下，该对象初始化为包含 `String`、`byte[]`、`ByteBuffer` 和 `DataBuffer` 解码器的实例。

    • decoders

      RSocketStrategies.Builder decoders(Consumer<List<Decoder<?>>> consumer)
      立即将消费者应用于配置的解码器列表。

    • routeMatcher

      RSocketStrategies.Builder routeMatcher(@Nullable RouteMatcher routeMatcher)
      Configure a RouteMatcher for matching routes to message handlers based on route patterns. This option is applicable to client or server responders.

      默认情况下，使用由带有"."作为分隔符的AntPathMatcher支持的SimpleRouteMatcher。为了提高效率，请考虑改用来自spring-web的PathPatternRouteMatcher。

    • reactiveAdapterStrategy

      RSocketStrategies.Builder reactiveAdapterStrategy(@Nullable ReactiveAdapterRegistry registry)
      Configure the registry for reactive type support. This can be used to adapt to, and/or determine the semantics of a given Publisher.

      默认情况下，此ReactiveAdapterRegistry.getSharedInstance()。

    • dataBufferFactory

      RSocketStrategies.Builder dataBufferFactory(@Nullable DataBufferFactory bufferFactory)
      Configure the DataBufferFactory to use for allocating buffers when preparing requests or creating responses.

      默认情况下，此值设置为 NettyDataBufferFactory，使用零拷贝的池化分配缓冲区。RSocket 也必须配置为支持零拷贝。对于客户端设置，RSocketRequester.Builder会自动适配此处配置的 DataBufferFactory，并在 RSocketConnector 中相应地设置帧解码器。对于服务器设置，RSocketServer 也必须相应配置以支持零拷贝。

      如果使用 `DefaultDataBufferFactory`，则无需对 RSocket 进行相关的配置更改。

    • metadataExtractor

      RSocketStrategies.Builder metadataExtractor(@Nullable MetadataExtractor metadataExtractor)
      Configure a MetadataExtractor to extract the route along with other metadata. This option is applicable to client or server responders.

      默认情况下，这是使用configured解码器创建的DefaultMetadataExtractor，并从"message/x.rsocket.routing.v0"元数据中提取路由。

    • metadataExtractorRegistry

      RSocketStrategies.Builder metadataExtractorRegistry(Consumer<MetadataExtractorRegistry> consumer)
      将消费者应用于MetadataExtractorRegistry，以注册额外的元数据条目提取器。
